# Data from Treasury Bulletin
# June 1991
europe_1991 = 268166  # millions
latam_1991 = 337565   # millions

# June 1996
europe_1996 = 426245  # millions  
latam_1996 = 443872   # millions

# Linear regression with Europe as predictor of Latin America
# We have 2 points, so the regression line passes through both points
import numpy as np

x = np.array([europe_1991, europe_1996])
y = np.array([latam_1991, latam_1996])

# Fit linear regression
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
print(f"Linear Regression:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope}")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept}")
print(f"  Equation: Latin America = {slope:.6f} * Europe + {intercept:.2f}")

# Verify the fit
y_pred_1991 = slope * europe_1991 + intercept
y_pred_1996 = slope * europe_1996 + intercept
print(f"\nVerification:")
print(f"  1991 predicted: {y_pred_1991}, actual: {latam_1991}")
print(f"  1996 predicted: {y_pred_1996}, actual: {latam_1996}")
EOF
